svg.title: Ethereum Storage Proof Verification
svg.desc: A two-level proof flow verifies the account against the block stateRoot, reads the account storageRoot, then verifies an individual storage slot proof against that storageRoot. It highlights slot calculation, trie-path hashing, and zero-value non-inclusion.
svg.text: Storage Proofs: Authenticate a Slot Value
Two proof layers connect a contract storage slot to an authenticated block header.
Verification chain
1. Authenticated block header
stateRoot commits to the global account-state trie
2. Verify accountProof
Recover the proven account record, including storageRoot
3. Determine the logical storage slot
Apply Solidity layout rules: variable, mapping, array, or packed field
4. Verify storageProof
MPT path derives from keccak256(32-byte slot key); nodes are RLP
5. Prove inclusion or non-inclusion
Decode the proven storage value or validate absence under storageRoot
Every root, proof, account, slot key, and value must refer to the same block.
Proof data from an RPC server is not verified until both layers are checked.
Key distinctions
Slot key ≠ trie path
RPC receives the 32-byte logical slot.
triePath = keccak256(slotKey)
Proof of a full storage word
Packed variables may share a slot.
Use layout offsets and masks to decode.
Zero can mean non-inclusion
Zero storage entries are normally absent.
Verify the absence proof against the root.
eth_getProof
accountProof + storageProof[key].proof
Reported value remains a claim until checked.
Remember
stateRoot → proven account → storageRoot → proven slot value. Authenticate the header separately.
